# Rolenaut - Direct-to-ATS Tech Jobs & Career Discovery

> Rolenaut autonomously indexes official enterprise career portals (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, SmartRecruiters) to deliver verified direct-to-ATS technical requisitions across all experience levels with zero recruiter spam.

## Canonical Platform Links
- [Live Tech Job Feed](https://rolenaut.netlify.app/jobs)
- [Home Overview](https://rolenaut.netlify.app/)

- [Technical Interview Blueprint](https://rolenaut.netlify.app/interview-prep)
